targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "battery_soc")

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p_battery")

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p_combined_generation")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "PV Generation (W)"}))

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p_grid_out")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "Power to Grid (W)"}))

pv = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p_combined_generation")

load = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p_load_demand")

join(tables: {pv: pv, load: load}, on: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _field: "House from PV (W)",
      _value: if r._value_pv < r._value_load then r._value_pv else r._value_load
  }))

pv = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p_combined_generation")

battery = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p_battery")

load = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p_load_demand")

j1 = join(tables: {pv: pv, load: load}, on: ["_time"])
j2 = join(tables: {j1: j1, battery: battery}, on: ["_time"])

j2
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      pvToLoad = if r._value_pv < r._value_load then r._value_pv else r._value_load
      battToLoad = if r._value < 0 then r._value * -1 else 0
      gridToLoad = r._value_load - pvToLoad - battToLoad
      return {
          _time: r._time,
          _field: "House from Grid (W)",
          _value: float(v: if gridToLoad > 0 then gridToLoad else 0)
      }
  })
